issues.problem: The ink now has a navy hue, but it renders as a mid-luminance saturated blue (#46629e to #5d74a3). JA795A is still a faint blue print, not the darkest mark on the wing. At sunset (s26K) the letters vanish into the blue wing because they share its hue.
evidence: w17K ink #5d74a3 / skin #b0b7c0, lum ratio 0.63; w26K ink #46629e / skin #acb4bd, 0.54
_7242 ink #2b2d30 / skin #b6b9bb (ratio ~0.24); KN41 reg is the darkest text on the wing; w5x raters 0.29-0.41 from _7250/_7331
issues.fix: In 11E ink: base #15264a with r 0.6 picks up the sky/ambient term (the blue rise is the env reflection on a mid-rough dielectric). Use { c: '#070b14', r: 0.95, m: 0 } and widen the stroke 0.27 -> 0.32 so MSAA coverage does not blend it toward the skin at 17K-26K grazing angles. Target ink/skin lum <= 0.40 in w26K and w17K (re-measure crop 330..450 x 165..200 in w17K).

issues.problem: After w5 the canoes are flat-sided slabs (section r = min(0.32 w, 0.3 d)). Their side faces render a flat uniform #535a67 to #b0b0b0 with a sharp chisel tail, so from 19A they read as saw-teeth or spikes and from 26K as flat paddles. The real flaps-up canoes are round-bottomed pods: a lit upper flank grading to a dark rounded keel, with a blunt rounded taper, not a needle.
evidence: ref/web/exterior/a5_kn_ANA77W_TheRoom_41.jpg (cruise, outboard canoes as short round pods)
19A: tail behind TE ~70 px vs depth ~30 px (2.3x); KN41 ~45 vs ~25 px (1.8x)
issues.fix: In the canoe loop's sec(): r = Math.min(w * 0.48, d * 0.45), so the keel is round and the flanks curve. Tail: lerp(1,0.2,...) -> lerp(1,0.35,...) for width and lerp(1,0.12,...) -> lerp(1,0.3,...) for depth, and drop the 0.9 pointed end section (keep u 0.5 only), so the end is a rounded blunt cone. Shorten the overhang 0.33*len -> 0.28*len. Keep the -25 % keel occlusion so the lower half grades dark.

issues.problem: The upper skin is still a near-uniform CG grey. The ANA photos show clear panel-to-panel tone steps, many visible fastener lines (chordwise rows on every spoiler/flap panel, spanwise rows), small red/black placards and grime streaks on the inboard flap/spoiler. The +-5 % panel jitter is invisible at window range. The lit inboard wing renders #8d96a4 against #b6bec9 in KN41 (partly lighting).
issues.fix: paintVerts: raise the panel jitter 0.10 -> 0.16, and use the spanwise splice/chordwise butt positions (skin lines) as the panel boundaries so the tone steps coincide with the seams. Add faint riv rows (0.012 m, #5a5d61) along each spoiler and flap panel edge, 0.1 m inside the seam. Add 3-4 small placards (0.25 x 0.12 m quads, #b3262a red border) on the inboard spoilers at s 5-8.

issues.problem: The inlet liner still darkens toward the far wall, so from 11A/11K the inlet is a black tube. In LALF _136 the far inner wall is lit and the liner grades lighter, from the lip shadow (#161f28) to #868e99.
issues.fix: The inlet shadeVerts factor depends only on depth (p[2]). Add an angular term so the inner wall facing the camera side (the outboard half for the A side, i.e. the normal pointing toward -x*side) gets x1.6. Raise the base inlet colour #5a6067 -> #6a7078 with r 0.5. Equivalent: multiply by 0.55 + 0.45*max(0, -n.x*side) as well.

issues.problem: The access panel is a wide 2.4:1 rectangle that sits almost against the lip (about 60 % of the way from the first split to the highlight), with a bold dark outline. In LALF _136/_137 it is near-square (about 1.25:1), sits about 35-42 % of the way from the split toward the lip, and its outline is a faint line barely darker than the cowl.
evidence: 11A render: panel center at ~(532-465)/(575-465) = 0.61 of split->lip; aspect ~2.5:1 in z11A
outline in render ~#4a5260 on #b8c2cd (ratio ~0.45); photo outline ratio ~0.8
issues.fix: In the access-panel block: size 0.50 x 0.32 -> 0.42 x 0.36 m, move its centre from ~0.85 m to ~0.80 m aft of the highlight only if the split stays at x=1.3 (i.e. place it at x = 0.15 + 0.6*(1.3-0.15)), and draw the outline with a seam-like material lightened to #8a8f95 (not the dark seam), width 0.012.

issues.problem: The strake shadow is now a wide, evenly dark lens (about 0.25 m deep) under the plate and reads like a slot or scoop cut into the cowl. In _137 and JAL 3371 the shadow is a thin dark line that tapers aft.
issues.fix: Halve the shadow band depth and taper it to zero at the aft end (scale its local width by 1 - t along the strake). Fade its colour from cowl*0.55 to cowl*0.9 at the edges, not a flat fill.

issues.problem: The slat trailing-edge line (gap, 0.03 m) is sub-pixel at 20-30 m and renders as a faint dotted line. In ZGriff-63, _7242 and KN41 it is one of the crispest dark lines on the wing, running root to tip.
issues.fix: spanPath(11.7,31.0, le+0.66) gap width 0.03 -> 0.05, and give the inboard slat line (le+0.95) the same.

issues.problem: The GE monogram added in w5 appears in none of the 11 rated views, so it cannot be checked. In IQCFQpV_T1A it sits low and aft on the inboard flank, visible from forward-of-wing seats at ground pitch.
issues.fix: No geometry change. Add a QA close-up view (e.g. 13A pitch -0.35) to verify its position and size before the next round.
